北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴热，体感 32℃。记得防晒补水，保持清爽哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny and hot, feels like 32℃. Stay hydrated and cool!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪小雨，体感 29℃，湿度大。出门带伞，注意防潮。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has light rain and high humidity. Don't forget your umbrella!
慈溪.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降9℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感高达 37℃。高温防暑，避免午后出行！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is very hot, feels like 37℃. Stay cool and avoid midday heat!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感 29℃，湿度高。记得防潮，保持好心情！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and humid, feels like 29℃. Stay fresh!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感 31℃，湿度高。多饮水，注意防晒哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and humid, feels like 31℃. Stay hydrated!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 30℃，风力 4 级。风大体感热，请注意防暑！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, feels like 30℃ with strong wind. Stay cool!
杭州.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京大雾，湿度 93%。注意能见度，出行请慢行，保重！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is foggy with high humidity. Drive safely and take care!
南京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴热，体感 36℃，湿度较低。多喝水，避免中暑哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny and hot, feels like 36℃. Stay hydrated and cool!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 34℃，湿度较大。多补水，注意防晒！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and humid, feels like 34℃. Hydrate and use sun protection!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴热，体感 37℃，湿度低。及时补水，小心中暑哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and hot, feels like 37℃. Stay hydrated to avoid heatstroke!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，体感 35℃。天气炎热，请注意防暑降温哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and hot, feels like 35℃. Stay cool!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴天，体感 30℃。温度适中，出门记得带伞。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy, feels like 30℃. A moderate day, bring your umbrella!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳大雨倾盆，湿度 99%。雨天路滑，注意安全，出门带伞。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang has heavy rain and high humidity. Drive carefully and bring an umbrella!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感 22℃。气温舒适，出门记得带件外套哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels like 22℃. Comfortable, but bring a light jacket!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感 30℃，风力 4 级。风大潮湿，请注意防晒。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, humid, feels like 30℃ with strong wind. Use sun protection!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛小雨，体感 26℃。雨天路滑，带伞出行，注意保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has light rain, feels like 26℃. Roads are slippery, bring an umbrella!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 29℃。天气舒适，出门散步是个不错的选择。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like 29℃. Comfortable weather, perfect for a walk!
